absent: Full memory_failure head including parameter validation, initial acquisition, folio splitting, and paths before the routed tail.
Implementations of shake_folio, folio lock and unlock, folio wait writeback, and folio flag test helpers.
Behavior of kill_procs_now, identify_page_state, hwpoison walk operations, and walk_page_range traversal.
Hugetlb helpers, folio try get and put, get_page_unless_zero, compound head resolution, and page to folio mapping.
Unmapping path including unmap_poisoned_folio, mapcount accounting, dirty propagation, and mlock handling.
Reverse mapping iterators and address lookup helpers for anonymous, file, and KSM mappings.
KSM stable node lifecycle, anon_vma lock primitives, task reference handling, and process iteration guarantees.
Tracing and accounting including trace events, block poison counts, node data layout, node lookup, and sysctl controls.
Signal delivery including forced and advisory machine check signals and privileged kill semantics.
Numeric values of error codes, flags, message types, shifts, masks, magic markers, and retry bounds.
Full struct layouts for task, address space, vma, folio, page, anon_vma, mapping, kill entry, and stats beyond observed uses.
Locking outside the tail including mutex acquisition scope, mmap lock nesting, and per cpu cache disable effects.

findings.text: Public helper that increments the global poisoned page count and updates memory block poison accounting for the supplied frame number.
Public collector that finds processes sharing a KSM folio through its stable node and queues early kill candidates.
Public helper that adds a task to the kill list for KSM pages unless that task is already present.
Public selector that returns no task when the process lacks an address space, returns the current thread for forced early handling of the same address space, otherwise delegates to thread scan.

Public acquisition helper that returns the read locked anon vma for a locked folio or null when not anonymous, unmapped, contended with try lock request, or after pinning reveals unmapped or last reference.

Recovery tail that handles split failure with process killing, then shakes and locks the folio, waits for writeback when needed, unmaps user mappings, filters truncated LRU, and finally delegates to page state identification.
Per task scan entry that walks the whole user address range under read lock to locate the poisoned frame and signal the owner when the walk reports a fatal hit with an address.
Reference acquisition wrapper that disables per cpu caches around either unpoison acquisition or general poison acquisition and then reenables them.

When splitting reports an error or leaves a nonzero order, the code refetches the folio, marks the result as hardware poison, kills processes immediately, releases the page reference, records an unsplit THP failure, and exits under mutex.

Non LRU pages without writeback skip unmapping and go directly to state identification, while other pages wait for writeback, require successful user unmapping, and treat an LRU page with empty mapping and no swap cache as truncated and ignored.
Page status flags are copied while the folio is locked because containment actions such as unmapping can clear flags like mlocked and would otherwise corrupt later classification.

Recovery reporting traces the event, skips global and per node accounting for already poisoned and pfn map types, logs the outcome, may panic on unrecoverable configuration, and maps recovered or delayed to success with other outcomes to busy failure.
Per node statistics resolve the node from the frame number, warn and return on invalid node, increment exactly one of ignored failed delayed recovered, and always increment total.
Unrecoverable panic is enabled only when the corresponding sysctl is set and the page type is kernel with result ignored.

General acquisition first rejects kernel owned pages with not recoverable and drops the extra reference when present, otherwise retries bounded times with shaking on busy or zero count races, and succeeds for huge or handlable pages while failing others with input output error after retries.
Handlability is false for slab, true for movable operations pages under soft offline, otherwise true only for LRU or free buddy pages.

Kernel ownership holds for reserved pages and for slab table or large kmalloc state observed on the compound head, with a retry when the head changes during observation to avoid trusting a stale view.

Poison acquisition first handles hugetlb with a demotion check that validates the folio still matches the page, then rejects non handlable folios as busy, then attempts a try get and only succeeds when the folio still matches, otherwise releases and reports no reference on tail mismatch.
Unpoison acquisition handles hugetlb with demotion validation, rejects pages already taken off the buddy list with hardware poison error, otherwise succeeds only when the page count was nonzero.
Taken off state is defined as the conjunction of hardware poison marking and a private field equal to a magic poison marker.

User mapping handling skips reserved slab table offline pages and pages that are neither LRU nor hugetlb and unmapped folios, otherwise collects processes before unmapping, re shakes mlocked folios after unmapping, and forces killing when dirty or must kill is set or unmapping failed.

Kill list draining sends an uncatchable kill when force is requested but no user address was found, otherwise sends an advisory machine check signal under force and logs failures, always unlinking freeing and releasing each entry.
Process collection returns immediately without mapping, and otherwise dispatches to KSM anonymous or file variants based on folio kind.

Kill entry creation allocates atomically and drops on failure, records the address, derives size shift from device mapping walk for zone device pages or folio shift otherwise, discards zone device entries with zero shift, logs unresolvable addresses, and appends with a task reference.
Device mapping shift walks page tables top down and returns zero on any missing level, returns pud shift for pud huge, pmd shift for pmd huge, page shift for present pte, otherwise zero.

Early kill thread scan returns the first thread with process machine check and early flags when process mode is set, otherwise returns the first thread when global early kill sysctl is enabled, else returns null.

Anonymous collection takes the anon vma read lock and returns when absent, computes the page offset, then under RCU scans all processes for an early kill thread and adds matching vmas with the same address space at the mapped address.

File collection locks the mapping for reading, computes the page offset, then under RCU scans all processes for an early kill thread and adds vmas with the same address space using the address in vma even when the pte may not map the page.

KSM collection resolves the stable node and returns when absent, then for each rmap item locks the anon vma for reading and under RCU scans all processes for an early kill thread and adds entries where vma address space matches.

Anon vma lookup requires the folio to be locked and to carry anonymous mapping flags and to be mapped, uses a try lock fast path with mapped revalidation, supports a try only mode that reports contention, otherwise pins the vma to sleep safely and handles last reference without deadlock.
Optional poison filter runs under RCU with a default allow result of zero and returns the filter outcome only when a filter is installed.

Process signalling logs the frame and process identity, uses a forced synchronous machine check error for the current task when action required is set, otherwise sends an asynchronous machine check error that may be blocked, and logs send failures.

Task killing returns fault when the task lacks an address space, otherwise walks the full user range and only signals when the walk reports one with a recorded address, mapping positive walk results to hardware poison error and others to success.
Page shaking delegates directly to folio shaking on the containing folio.
KSM addition skips tasks already queued, and anonymous file addition silently drops entries whose address lookup failed.

The recovery tail holds the memory failure mutex across the whole tail and holds the folio lock from shaking through unmapping and state checks, releasing folio then mutex on failure paths and mutex only on the identified state path.
Filter lookup and invocation occur inside an RCU read critical section.
The full user range walk runs under the target address space read lock which is released before returning.
Anonymous and KSM collection hold the anon vma read lock while scanning processes under RCU, and file collection holds the mapping read lock while scanning under RCU.

Lookup starts under RCU with a root read try lock and mapped revalidation, and on try lock failure pins the vma reference, drops RCU to sleep on the read lock, then handles last reference release without recursive locking.
Per cpu page caches for the page zone are disabled across poison or unpoison reference acquisition and reenabled afterwards.
Observed kill entry carries a task pointer, a user address that may hold a fault marker, a size shift derived from mapping, and a list node linking entries in the kill list.
Observed walk context carries a frame number plus an embedded kill record holding task and address used to decide signalling after the range walk.
Observed per node failure statistics maintain separate counters for ignored failed delayed recovered and a total incremented on every accounted event.

Observed folio and page state includes flags, mapping pointer, private marker, map counts, and LRU swap cache dirty mlocked reserved slab table offline hugetlb KSM anonymous and writeback attributes consulted during classification.

Acquisition retries form a bounded loop with pass counting: kernel owned terminates as not recoverable, zero count or free buddy mismatch retries, busy with shaking retries, handlable or huge succeeds, otherwise after the bound fails.

Tail phases progress from split validation to shake and lock, to writeback handling, to unmap requirement, to truncated filtering, to identification, with early exits to mutex release on split failure, unmap failure, or truncated ignored.

Result mapping treats recovered and delayed as success and all other results including ignored and failed as busy failure, with tracing and accounting preceding the mapping except for two excluded message types.
Page type bits live only on the head so a concurrent split or free could change the head mid check; the code rereads the head and retries to avoid trusting stale ownership.
Splitting can replace the original folio so the code refetches the folio from the page after split failure handling and asserts a reference is held to prevent reconstitution as large.
Hugetlb demotion may occur underneath acquisition so the code revalidates that the folio still contains the page after hugetlb handling and releases the stale reference on mismatch.
A try get can race with tail reuse so success requires the folio still matching the page, otherwise the reference is dropped and acquisition reports no page.
Pinning the last anon vma reference then sleeping on its lock risks recursive release deadlock, so the code unlocks and uses the raw put path when the pin was last.
Kill entry allocation uses atomic context and on failure only logs and returns, silently omitting that victim from notification.
Locking and flag copying are required because mlocked and writeback LRU transitions can occur without the folio lock, and the reclaim isolation check may needlessly skip LRU pages under reclaim walk.

Observed error markers include EHWPOISON and EBUSY and EFAULT and EIO and ENOTRECOVERABLE used to distinguish fatal poison and contention and missing address space and unhandlable pages and kernel owned pages.

Observed control flags include MF_ACTION_REQUIRED and MF_MUST_KILL and MF_COUNT_INCREASED and MF_UNPOISON and MF_SOFT_OFFLINE which select synchronous signalling and forced killing and reference handling and unpoison path and movable migration.

Observed message types include MF_MSG_UNSPLIT_THP and MF_MSG_UNMAP_FAILED and MF_MSG_TRUNCATED_LRU and MF_MSG_ALREADY_POISONED and MF_MSG_PFN_MAP and MF_MSG_KERNEL with results MF_IGNORED and MF_FAILED and MF_DELAYED and MF_RECOVERED that drive stats and success mapping.
Observed signalling constants include BUS_MCEERR_AR and BUS_MCEERR_AO and SIGKILL and SEND_SIG_PRIV and PIDTYPE_PID and PF_MCE_PROCESS and PF_MCE_EARLY plus a global early kill control.

Observed layout markers include MAGIC_HWPOISON and PAGE_SHIFT and PUD_SHIFT and PMD_SHIFT and PAGE_MASK and FOLIO_MAPPING_ANON and FOLIO_MAPPING_FLAGS and GET_PAGE_MAX_RETRY_NUM and TASK_SIZE and GFP_ATOMIC.
